purpose: Explicit game-scaled starting factory counts for all 197 core OMEGA countries and each of the 21 canonical factory types.

model.oneUnitMeaning: One abstract starting factory unit in the strategy simulation; it is not a census of a physical factory.
principles: Use the existing 21-type canonical factory catalog.
Every core country gets every factory type key, including explicit zero counts.
Keep industrial specialisation and resource context distinct from raw mineral reserves or current inventory.
Counts are scaled for gameplay and never copied directly from real-world facility totals.
Country counts are a starting baseline; later player construction/upgrades are tracked separately.

provenance.note: Game-scaled starting allocation informed by the country's broad industrial strengths and resource context. Counts are abstract game units, not observed factory censuses or real-world facility counts.
